methodological_rigor.justification: The manuscript consists only of a title indicating a retracted status and lacks any description of study design, methodology, or statistical analysis. Without information on sample size, control groups, or specific tests used, it is impossible to verify the rigor or appropriateness of the research.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: The study is classified as LoE 2b as it describes an individual cohort study investigating the association between BRD7 expression and prostate cancer progression. The clinical relevance is scored as 1 because the manuscript is explicitly marked as retracted, which invalidates the findings and removes any potential for clinical or translational impact.

reporting_quality.justification: The manuscript is marked as retracted and contains no content beyond the title, making it impossible to evaluate adherence to the REMARK or STROBE checklists. There is no description of methodology, results, or data availability.

novelty_literature.justification: The manuscript provides an incremental extension of the known tumor-suppressive role of BRD7, which has been extensively characterized in other malignancies, to the context of prostate cancer. The study relies on standard descriptive methodology (IHC and basic in vitro assays) and lacks conceptual novelty.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript is entirely missing all essential sections, including the abstract, introduction, methods, results, and discussion. Only a title is provided, which prevents any evaluation of clarity, organization, or scientific presentation.

The submission contains no scientific content beyond the title.
